name: Duke Pre-College Programs (High School)
org: Duke University, Office of the Provost
what_you_do: Duke runs residential summer academic programs on its campus. They are for high school students. Students must be at least 14 to attend.
who_can_apply: High school students in current grades 9 to 12 who are at least 14 to attend. (The page also lists middle school programs for grades 6-8.)
pay_detail: 2027 residential fee not yet posted (Duke lists it as to be determined). Enrollment deposit: $500 before April 2, 2027, or $1,500 after April 1. Airport shuttle $45 each way; extra nights $120 each.
duration: Three sessions; dates to be announced in October 2026
deadline_text: No application deadline listed. Full payment is due 30 days before each session; immunization proof due June 1, 2027; full refund for cancellations before April 1, 2027.
how_to_apply: Join the information request list on the Duke Pre-College page to be told when 2027 dates and courses open.
notes: Courses, session dates and fees for Summer 2027 were not posted on 2026-10-09. Check back after the October 2026 announcement.
